description: Machine-readable catalog of reusable agent skills in this plugin.

wiki-ingest.when: When the user wants to ingest material into the LLM Wiki.

wiki-lint.when: When the user wants to check or clean up the LLM Wiki.

wiki-query.when: When the user wants to query the LLM Wiki for knowledge.

wiki-html.when: When the user wants an interactive HTML page produced for and archived into the LLM Wiki.
